reviews.comment: She is an intelligent person but the class is just scattered everywhere. If you work well with having to sift through 4 different tabs just to find all the instructions then you will be fine. But if you are like me and like things to be clear then you won't have much fun or learning here.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Standard online technical writing for engineering majors. Just do the discussion boards and the assignments and don't use AI. There's really no point in using AI since you'll get most of the credit for the assignment anyways. Very organized professor, and you'll know exactly what you need to do during the week. Def best option for this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor, not very many assignments but the few assignments given are very lengthy. A LOT of reading, and the books can be boring. 2 written exams are given, and extra credit was offered on the final due to completing course evals. If you are willing to READ every week and come to class take this course. We also watched 2 movies in class.

While I do recommend Dr. Baca, I recommend taking her class if you have a light course load because her class is reading-intensive and it would take hours to read/annotate outside of class. The silver lining for her class is that she allowed us to use study guides for the midterm/final exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Baca! She is really cool. Definitely my favorite prof this semester. For this course, keep up with the readings, listen, and take note of what she says during lectures. What she mentions is that class will usually be on exams. This is a reading-intensive course, if you know you won't keep up with the schedule don't take the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So much reading! The time allotted for her midterm was not enough for what she was requiring us to do, many people didn't finish on time. Rarely open to feedback and would visibly get upset by it. Some of her claims about the readings assigned were not textually supported and we often disagreed with her. Good luck if you miss just one class!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Don't take if you just need an English credit. She assigns way too much reading so you'll have no free time, on top of other assignments. She has two exams, the final being worth 35% of your grade, and they're both fully written. Don't miss more than two days of class or your grade drops by 5%. If you don't like reading do not take her trust me
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Baca was a great professor! She's very passionate about the class and really just wants participation and engagement more than anything else. She's not a tough grader as long as you put in some earnest effort, and there are only a handful of assignments so the workload isn't very intense.

If you value your free time, do not take this class. You can only miss 2 classes before a 5% deduction is taken from your letter grade and her readings are long and heavy. The tests are designed to trick you and the assignments are unnecessarily long and harshly graded. Nice woman though.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Baca's in-person section this semester, and she has been a great teacher! We had discussions in class, and the projects are both helpful and interesting. You will do well if you complete all the assignments according to her rubrics and on time.

Discussion post after discussion post. Especially at the end of the semester, there were a lot of writing assignments that had no purpose. Don't know if this is the nature of the course or it's the prof. She grades harshly on many things, and people complained, so she changed her grading approach. Do not take this course with other hard classes.

I did more assignments for this elective alone than I did for my major coursework classes COMBINED. If you're taking hard/other time consuming classes, avoid this course. Way too many long assignments that didn't serve a purpose and a lot of them had unclear instructions, which really did not help. She cut a lot of points for small mistakes.

Dr. Baca's class was super easy. There were a lot of writing assignments and discussion boards, 2 individual and 2 group projects. If you get lucky with a good group, it will be smooth sailing. She was really responsive at the beginning of the semester and then I just couldn't reach her via email ever. But she basically gives everyone a 100.

Professor Baca is a kind, caring, and flexible professor. Despite challenges this semester, she adapted perfectly. She treated students with respect, and we returned it. Her class uses a grading contract you agree to and may adjust overtime. Group projects were mandatory but fun. Lot's of prep throughout the semester - less assignments.
Very clear guidelines on how to get an A. Grades were based on completion and participation. Class was fun, and she was willing to change the plan to make the class better.

She was fine. I had her for 231 but there was no option. If you want an easy A, take her. If you want to learn something, don't take her. I really don't like when professors try to be like buddies with their students, so I just didn't like her class very much. Just teach me! Yeah just kind of a meh class (would take again bc SUPER SUUPER easy A)

Was the sweetest prof that I've ever taken! She is very clear on web assignments are due and posts the entire sem assignments dem da one. The group project was a little iffy but I reached out and she answered my questions clearly. Def recommend her!

You can't NOT read the book that your discussions will be over. You will need to read that book cover to cover, but generally, this is a pretty good class, and I would recommend it. She's funny and pretty real.

LOVE Dr.B! She had organized 203 in a different way than "usual", but our whole class enjoyed her approach! She cares about her students and wants everyone to get the grade they feel they deserve. No exams, just projects/essays, and various discussion posts. I would 100% recommend Dr. B and I'm sure the other classes she teaches are great also!

If you complete every assignment posted onCanvas by the due date and fulfill rubric requirements for each assignment, you automatically receive an A. The group project did prove to be more work than I expected, but my group did a lot of procrastinating. Expect to spend around 3 hours per week on assignments.

This is a literature class, so read! The reading isn't hard, just don't procrastinate. You choose your grade, and you can skip discussion posts and lectures based on what grade you contract for. I think there was one really easy final reflection essay, other than it's just reading, discussion posts, and you have to do small group discussion twice.

Dr. Baca truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed! Grade is based off of what you contract at the beginning of the semester and work towards that grade. Grades consist of discussion posts, 2 essays and a group project. Very straight forward class and I would definitely take her again. She is great!!

Great professor! Very understanding of heavy courseloads and exam-heavy periods of the semester, encouraged class discussion and the potential for discussion to move onto other topics than those proposed, very focused on making sure that students understand what is going on in the course. You pick homework amount for a grade, which is super nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took Baca for my 210 course. Grades were based on a grade contract and she was very clear about the steps you need to take to achieve the grade you had assigned yourself in the contract. As long as you're not ignoring your assignments, you'll get the grade you want. There is group work and she was very understanding about issues with submissions.

This class had almost 50 different assignments throughout its entirety. If you are taking any other classes that will consume most of your time, do not take this class. The amount of work we had to do for a 200 level class was insane. Grades are based on a grade contract and assignments are graded by completion and attention to instruction.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: So I actually had Michaela for ENGL 313 but it wouldn't let me select that. She is seriously so amazing. I'm already the type of person to be interested in Medieval literature, but she made me even more interested and passionate. Everything is a participation grade. It is a decent amount of work (I wrote about 20,000 words), but so fun.

PROS: Understanding and accommodating. Low intensity and low stakes classroom setting. Again very accommodating and very helpful. 
CONS: "Make a 350 word discussion posts and respond to at least 2 peers in no less than 150 wo..." Crass, seems to hold the society she studies in contempt 
NA: Did not make me question my sexuality
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Amazing Professor! Very kind and caring teacher who has helped me a lot even outside the coursework. She teaches in such a fun way and overall will make you enjoy what she is teaching. Very down to Earth professor and honestly the best professor I have had during my 3 years at Texas A&M University. If you have issues email her and she will help.

The way she formats her class is awesome. I love how we get to pick and choose which assignments we want to do, this allows me a lot of flexibility if one of my other classes bombards me with assignments without notice. If you don't like her format, you've gotta be braindead!

Every class period a discussion post is due including replies to the last discussion post. You make your own requirements based on the grade contract you sign. For example, an A contract means the 2 papers you write have to be 1250 words, you have to complete 20 out of 23 discussion posts, and you can miss 6 classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: This is the BEST English professor I have ever had. I always enjoyed showing up to class even if I have never been a huge fan on English or literature as a whole. The class is just like the other commenters describe; if you submit the work you selected on your grade contract, you will end up with that grade. Take this prof for Engl 203.

You choose your grade as long as you make the criteria you'll do just fine. She is a kind and caring teacher and will work with her students to make it a fun and enjoyable learning experience. There are a few assignments that might take a little bit but its not too hard. There are 3 essays that are word number requirements but it's not too bad.

Took her for 104 and it was an incredibly easy class. You basically pick the grade you want and if you follow the correct word count requirement and correct amount of sources then you'll get that grade. She was also a fun teacher. Definitely take her English 104!

She was one of my favorite professors at A&M so far! I can not recommend her enough! She treats you as a person before a student, and is understanding of individual needs. Only essays, weekly annotation assignments, and reading which was all manageable. No grades, instead she used a grade contract- do the work/requirements for your desired grade.
THE BEST. TAKE HER CLASS IF YOU LOVE YOURSELF
If you do all the work, you get a B. If you complete the 3 extra assignments, you get an A. You choose your grade, its all about completion.
she is so kind and funny. i learned a lot in this course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I can not say enough good things about Ms. Baca. She is understanding and truly allows for individualization throughout the course. Coming from someone who is not a fan of English, she made this class easy to enjoy. The syllabus seems strict, but she is lenient if the class as a whole needs more time on an assessment. Take this class!!!
one of the best teachers I've had here yet. She actually made English not boring by not making you do nonsense work. #1 choice for English 104 no doubt.

Ms. Baca was my favorite teacher of this semester. She understands the struggles of college students because she is still a graduate student. She worked with our class whenever we needed help or more time. Her syllabus seems hard, but it is because the English department all have the same ones. She really is amazing and I recommend her to anyone.

Ms. Baca is AMAZING. She is kind, extremely personable, and smart. Her teaching style allows each student to find their niche and really dive into it. We had various writing assignments that were expansive and the topics are on what you want them to be. So it's fun! She is very outgoing in class and outside of class and any student would love her.
